how_to_reach: Take TSRTC Bus 288D directly from Mehdipatnam Bus Depot or drive via the Vikarabad highway.

nearest_railway_station.name: Hyderabad Deccan Railway Station (Nampally)
nearest_railway_station.connectivity: Well connected to the temple via city buses or direct taxi/auto-rickshaw services from the station exit.

nearest_airport.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in Shamshabad, Hyderabad

bus_routes: Direct Bus Route 288D from Mehdipatnam Bus Depot directly to Chilkur Balaji Temple (Frequent services daily, extra frequency on weekends).
Connecting Bus from Koti / Secunderabad to Mehdipatnam, then transfer to 288D.
Any regional bus towards Vikarabad/Chevella from Mehdipatnam; alight at Moinabad junction and take a local auto-rickshaw (~3 km).
road_routes: NH163 highway network via Mehdipatnam, Langar Houz, and Moinabad.
parking_info: Spacious parking area for private vehicles, buses, and two-wheelers outside the temple outer boundary.
